keyword.zh: 柴油30和柴油40混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 柴油30和柴油40混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Diesel 30 prints engine 4105 / 56 kW and 15 m³/h. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW and 26 m³/h.
description.zh: 柴油30印发动机 4105 / 56 kW 和 15 m³/h。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW 和 26 m³/h。

h1.zh: 柴油30和柴油40混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 30 and Diesel 40 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, distance 60 m / 180 m and aggregate 3 cm and below. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, distance 120 m / 360 m and a Kawasaki 112. Diesel 40's specification table does not print an aggregate row.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油30和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m、骨料 3 cm 及以下。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m 和川崎112。柴油40的规格表没有骨料行。

heading.en: Where Diesel 30 and Diesel 40 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油30和柴油40哪些数值不同

body.en: Diesel engine power: Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW; Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW. Theoretical output: Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h; Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa; Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Hopper capacity: Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³; Diesel 40 prints 0.4 m³. Pumping distance (H / V): Diesel 30 prints 60 m / 180 m; Diesel 40 prints 120 m / 360 m. Dimensions: Diesel 30 prints 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm; Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW；柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW。理论输送量：柴油30印 15 m³/h；柴油40印 26 m³/h。最大出口压力：柴油30印 20 MPa；柴油40印 25 MPa。料斗容积：柴油30印 0.3 m³；柴油40印 0.4 m³。输送距离（水平/垂直）：柴油30印 60 m / 180 m；柴油40印 120 m / 360 m。外形尺寸：柴油30印 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm；柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 30 prints cells that Diesel 40 does not: Max. aggregate size 3 cm and below. Diesel 40 prints cells that Diesel 30 does not: Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油30有、柴油40没有的行：最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。柴油40有、柴油30没有的行：液压泵 Kawasaki 112。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The next diesel numeral is a different engine code, not a small edit to the same row. Open /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30 and /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 下一个柴油编号对应另一套发动机代号，不是同一行的小改动。看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/，看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 print the same diesel engine power as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油30和柴油40的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油30和柴油40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30印 15 m³/h。柴油40印 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 print the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 柴油30和柴油40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa. Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30印 20 MPa。柴油40印 25 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is max. aggregate size missing on Diesel 40?
question.zh: 为什么柴油40没有最大骨料粒径？

answer.en: The Diesel 40 page does not print that label. Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油40这一页没有印这个标题。柴油30印的是 3 cm and below。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
